```{python}
import _lib as L
import itables
itables.init_notebook_mode(all_interactive=False, connected=True)

k = L.csv("kandydaci.csv")
k.insert(2, "form_changed", (k["forma_podstawowa"] != k["forma_kandydata"]).map({True: "yes", False: ""}))
front = ["forma_podstawowa", "forma_kandydata", "form_changed", "kategoria", "typ_szumu", "pelny_termin", "pojecie", "obrazowalnosc",
         "do_przegladu", "zgodnosc_glosow", "kand_przedmiotowy", "kand_ogolny", "dlugosc", "pos",
         "freq_cel", "freq_kontrast", "n_mat_cel", "n_przedmiotow", "zipf_kwjp", "zipf_zpe"]
front = [c for c in front if c in k.columns]
k = k[front + [c for c in k.columns if c not in front]]
n = lambda v: L.fmt(int(v))
labelled = k["kategoria"] != "nieklasyfikowany"
```

```{python}
L.table([
    ("Rows", n(len(k))),
    ("… candidates from the biology materials", n(k["kand_przedmiotowy"].sum())),
    ("… general candidates (other subjects only)", n((~k["kand_przedmiotowy"]).sum())),
    ("Labelled by the models", n(labelled.sum())),
    ("Not sent to the models (`nieklasyfikowany`)", n((~labelled).sum())),
    ("Base form corrected by the models (`form_changed`)", n((k["form_changed"] == "yes").sum())),
    ("Duplicates after correction, left out of the pools (`duplikat_formy`)", n(k["duplikat_formy"].notna().sum())),
], ["", "Count"], "lr")
```

`forma_kandydata` is the string that was counted; `forma_podstawowa` is the base form after correction. Filter with
the boxes under the header (for example `T3` under `kategoria`), click a header to sort, **Columns** shows the hidden
scores, ranks and each model's label and reason. How candidates are extracted and labelled:
[Method](method.qmd#candidates).

```{python}
L.source("kandydaci.csv")
L.glossary(k.columns)
```

```{python}
hidden = [c for c in k.columns if c.startswith("rank_") or c.endswith(("_pewnosc", "_uzasadnienie"))] + [
    "lematy", "cls", "n_mat_kontrast", "n_klas_cel", "rozproszenie", "termopl_ok", "kategoria_final", "model_sedzia",
    "udzial_nazw_wlasnych", "ll_vs_kwjp", "log_ratio_kwjp", "freq_kwjp", "zipf_wordfreq", "duplikat_formy", "warianty",
    "freq_cel_laczna", "freq_kontrast_laczna", "srebrny_pojecie_ref"]
L.dt(k, order=[[list(k.columns).index("freq_cel"), "desc"]], hide=hidden, wrap=["pojecie", "pelny_termin", "warianty"])
```
